description: Displayed on the palace lawn beside the 8 April 1975 bomb-damage marker. The palace's own site states this is an equivalent example (hien vat dong dang) of the aircraft flown by Nguyen Thanh Trung when he bombed the palace, not the original airframe. Wears the number 01638 and retains former Republic of Vietnam markings with black overpainting.
Huey preserved on the palace roof helipad; the palace describes it as a helicopter that served presidential transport. A visitor report reads the number 45.
